description: Find fossil collections (localities) by collection IDs, taxon, geologic time, place, formation, lithology, or environment. Each locality returns modern and reconstructed coordinates when recorded, age, strata, lithology, depositional environment, and a scoped occurrence-record count. Results page inline via limit/offset within the attempted batch. If remaining_collection_nos is present, finish the current pages, then pass those IDs as collection_no with the same filters and offset 0. Pass a single collection_no from a locality row to paleobiology_search_occurrences to see the recorded fauna.

base_id.description: Clade-inclusive taxon filter by PBDB taxon id — the accepted_no from paleobiology_get_taxon or an occurrence row. Same semantics as base_name, but unambiguous where a name is not (homonyms, synonyms, unresolved spellings). Supply this or base_name, never both.

base_name.description: Clade-inclusive taxon filter — localities yielding this taxon or its descendants, e.g. "Dinosauria". Supply this or base_id, never both.

collection_no.description: Filter to 1–10,000 PBDB collection IDs, such as collection_no values from paleobiology_search_occurrences. The first 1,000 distinct IDs are attempted in input order, with other filters narrowing the results. Page that batch before submitting remaining_collection_nos.

country.description: PBDB country/continent codes, comma-separated; ! excludes a list and ^ subtracts a code, e.g. NOA,^US.

county.description: County or other sub-state division name as recorded by PBDB, e.g. "Brewster". Pair with state and country to disambiguate; coverage may be incomplete.

environment.description: Depositional environment: "marine", "terrestrial", or "freshwater" (lacustrine + fluvial). Omit for all.

formation.description: Stored geologic formation name or PBDB list/wildcard expression, e.g. "Hell Creek"; passed unchanged, without stripping Formation, Group, or Member.

interval.description: Named geologic interval bounding the age, e.g. "Maastrichtian". Takes precedence over max_ma and min_ma.

latmax.description: Northern edge of the bounding box, decimal degrees (−90…90). Valid on its own — a lone latitude edge filters as a half-plane.

latmin.description: Southern edge of the bounding box, decimal degrees (−90…90). Valid on its own — a lone latitude edge filters as a half-plane.

limit.description: Number of localities requested for this page (default 25). The server serves at most 10000 per call, and this deployment may serve fewer. The notice discloses the cap when applied. Pair with offset to page through matches.

lithology.description: Lithology (rock type) to filter by, e.g. "sandstone".

lngmax.description: Eastern edge of the bounding box, decimal degrees (−180…180). Longitude is a closed pair — supply lngmin with it or neither.

lngmin.description: Western edge of the bounding box, decimal degrees (−180…180). Longitude is a closed pair — supply lngmax with it or neither.

max_ma.description: Older age bound in millions of years ago. Ignored when interval is supplied. When paired with min_ma it must be strictly greater — max_ma is the deeper-time end of the window.

min_ma.description: Younger age bound in millions of years ago. Ignored when interval is supplied. When paired with max_ma it must be strictly smaller — min_ma is the nearer-to-present end of the window.

offset.description: Number of localities to skip — page with limit by advancing offset.

state.description: State or province name as recorded by PBDB, e.g. "Texas". Pair with country to disambiguate; coverage may be incomplete.

name: paleobiology_search_collections

attribution.description: CC-BY data attribution for the Paleobiology Database.

cap.description: The per-page limit that was applied (set when truncated).

items.description: A fossil collection (locality) with its age, strata, lithology, and environment.

cc.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, when known.

collection_no.description: PBDB collection (locality) ID. Pass it as the single collection_no filter on paleobiology_search_occurrences to see the fauna found here.

early_interval.description: Named interval of the older age bound, e.g. "Late Maastrichtian".

environment.description: Depositional environment as PBDB recorded it (finer than the filter enum), when known.

lat.description: MODERN latitude of the locality (where the rock is today).

late_interval.description: Named interval of the younger bound — present when the age spans two intervals.

lithology_description.description: Plain-text lithology description with paragraph and line breaks, when recorded.

lng.description: MODERN longitude of the locality (where the rock is today).

max_ma.description: Older age bound in millions of years ago.

min_ma.description: Younger age bound in millions of years ago.

n_occs.description: Number of fossil occurrence records at this locality within n_occs_scope.

n_occs_scope.description: Scope of n_occs: collection counts all occurrence records; taxon_filter counts records matching base_name or base_id, including descendants and synonyms.

paleomodel.description: PBDB model used for the paleocoordinates.

reference_no.description: PBDB bibliographic reference id — the publication this collection was entered from. Resolve it to a full citation with paleobiology_get_references.

secondary_lithology.description: Second lithology, when recorded by PBDB.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `missing_filter`: The call carried only pagination fields — no collection, taxon, time, place, formation, lithology, or environment filter. `conflicting_taxon_filter`: Both base_name and base_id were supplied — PBDB accepts only one clade selector. `incomplete_bbox`: Exactly one of lngmin/lngmax was supplied — a longitude box needs both edges. `inverted_ma_range`: min_ma was greater than or equal to max_ma — the age window is inverted or empty. `pbdb_invalid_parameter`: PBDB refused a filter value it could not use, such as an unknown interval or lithology name — the message quotes its reason. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Applied filters and guidance when no locality matched, localities remain past this page, offset ran past the match set, or PBDB ignored a filter value.

remaining_collection_nos.description: Unattempted distinct collection IDs in input order, identical across pages for the same batch. After its final page, use these as collection_no with the same filters and offset 0.

shown.description: Number of localities returned in this page (set when truncated).

totalCount.description: Total localities matching the filters upstream across all pages of the attempted batch.

truncated.description: True when localities remain past this page — advance offset for more.

title: paleobiology-mcp-server: search fossil collections
